name: Turing
author: E. T. Carter
description: A reaction-diffusion surface — the dense maze of worm-like ridges and isolated spots a Gray-Scott activator-inhibitor system settles into. Ridges fork, merge and end in rounded caps, shaded as a low relief over a dark cavity floor, while a slow bias sweeps regions between labyrinth and spot regimes as the chemistry morphs.

params.label: Ridge scale
params.effect: CSS-pixel wavelength of the ridges; low is a fine dense maze, high is a few fat worms.

params.label: Morph
params.effect: How fast the chemistry morphs; 0 freezes the pattern.

params.label: Spots
params.effect: Regime bias: 0 is a connected labyrinth of ridges, 1 breaks it into isolated spots.

params.label: Wander
params.effect: How far the ridges wander from straight; 0 is calm fingerprint-like bands, high is a writhing maze.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Depth of the ridge shading; 0 is a flat stencil, high is a deeply embossed tube relief.
